newsitem.title: USA: Solv-ex named in class action lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Solv-ex named in class action lawsuit.

text.p: Solv-Ex Corp shareholders filed a class action lawsuit against the company and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Inc, alleging violations of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the plaintiff's lawyers said on Friday.

The lawyers said the complaint charged the company, certain Solv-Ex officers and directors and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell with misrepresenting the company's business prospects, technologies and reserves, among other things.
Solv-Ex and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were not immediately available to comment.
Lawyers Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP said the complaint charged these parties with also allegedly misrepresenting the value of Solv-Ex.
The complaint said because of a series of allegedly materially false and misleading statements, the price of Solv-Ex's common stock was artificially inflated during the so-called class period.
The class action suit was filed on behalf of all persons who bought or otherwise acquired Solv-Ex stock between February 15, 1995 and September 30, 1996.
Schiffrin & Craig Ltd also represented the plaintiffs.
